award.title: SBIR Phase I:  Ultra-High Throughput COVID-19 Serology Test Using a Novel Biomarker Multiplexing System
award.abstractText: The broader impact/commercial potential of this Small Business Innovation Research (SBIR) Phase I project is to create a rapid, inexpensive, and ultra-high throughput test to screen patients for antibodies against the SARS-CoV-2 virus that causes COVID-19.
